0.name: Prompt (PLUGIN)
0.content:
<scene_tracking>
Directive = Scene_tracking
Action = AFTER_main_response (confirm_it_was_LAST)
Not_using_<scene>_tags = FAILURE
<scene> = update_current_scene_info

calendar_format_and_info = {{getvar::sw_cal_prompt}}
last_scene_date = {{getvar::sw_cal_now}};
last_scene_info = {{getvar::sw_infer_scene}};
last_scene_attires = {{getvar::sw_infer_attires}};
important_events = {{getvar::sw_cal_events}};
today_events = {{getvar::sw_cal_today_event}}
today_moon_phase_info = {{getvar::sw_cal_today_moon}}

Output:
<scene>
**Time skip:** Yes/No? IF Yes -> Yes, how_much_time
**Time:** hour_and_minutes_fullday_format (eg.: 06:47)
**Date:** day_month_year (eg.: 04 of May, 2023)
**Weather:** [Rain, Sunny, Cloudy, Thunderstorm, etc]
**Temperature:** in_Celsius (eg.: 12°C)
**Important Event Today:** Yes/No? IF Yes -> Yes, event_name
**New Important Event:** Yes/No? IF Yes -> Yes, new_event_name in day_month_year (hour_and_minutes | fullday)

**Current Attires:**
**character_name is wearing:** attire_descripion
**other_character_name is wearing:** attire_descripion
(repeat_for_every_character_in_scene)
</scene>
RULES = [use_line_break, follow_format_exactly, MUST_be_last, MUST_use_<scene>_tags]
</scene_tracking>
